sampling: Census of all 50 newly ranked datasets; fresh bounded resource samples plus targeted documentation/secondary-resource checks

items.title: ASIC – Credit Licensee Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: CSV row 2: RELI CAPITAL LTD, mixed identifier 80005443292, credit licence 219612. Licence-holder business records; licence status is not entity status.

items.title: ASIC - Australian Financial Services Licensee Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: CSV rows 2–3: IPIB PTY LTD / 85007186003 and IMC PACIFIC PTY LTD / 89099273846. Identifiable AFS holders; mixed ABN/ACN requires length and checksum handling.

items.title: ASIC - Company Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: TSV rows 2–3 share ACN 000000019 and ABN 89000000019 across LOVINI HOLDINGS and MONAKA names. Current/historic name distinction matters; rows are not separate companies.

items.title: ASIC – Australian Financial Services Authorised Representative Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Follow-up raw CSV rows 5–6 identify NETWEALTH PTY LTD / ACN 119484043 and ASPIRA ADVICE SOLUTIONS PTY LTD / 627832820. Mixture of individuals and companies; representative is distinct from appointing licensee.

items.title: ASIC – Credit Representative Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Follow-up CSV row 23 identifies BOQ SPECIALIST PTY LTD / 94110704464; row 24 BAYMAN PTY. LIMITED / 60003993388. Mixed individual and organisation representatives; do not merge with licence holder.

items.title: ASIC - Business Names Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Rows 2–3 identify Plumbing Gas and Solar and Bruce Ward Training with BN_ABN values. Business-name subjects qualify, but name/ABN ownership semantics still need explicit mapping and review.

items.title: ABN Bulk Extract
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Downloaded CSV is a resource index. Publisher bulk-extract PDF pages 3–5 defines ABN/entity/legal-name records in XML, supporting relevance through documentation. Bulk XML rows were not inspected; CSV metadata overstates shared-engine readiness.

items.title: Victorian liquor licences split by licence type
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Both sampled official-linked CloudFront licence-category CSV URLs returned HTTP 404. Metadata is plausible, but rows were unavailable. Jev 0.94 is not verification.

items.title: ASIC – Self-Managed Super Fund Auditor Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Follow-up row 9 has SMSF_CAPACITY_FIRM_NAME GPP Audit Pty Limited. Main subject is an individual auditor; employer firm is a secondary organisation. Auditor ABN must not be assigned to that firm.

items.title: Research and Development tax incentive
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: 2022-23 Report sheet includes (UI!) THE URBAN INSTITUTE PTY LTD / 95608464535 and @HOME ARCHITECTURE PTY LTD / 53666147271. Information sheet precedes organisation-level expenditure records.

items.title: Corporate Tax Transparency
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Income-tax workbook describes entity-level disclosures and contains named companies and ABNs. Introductory sheet explains reporting scope; entity-level relevance does not settle tax-group identity or dates.

items.title: ASIC - Banned and Disqualified Organisations Dataset
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: CSV row 2 names AUSTRALIAN BUSINESS INSURANCE ADVISERS (ABIA) PTY LTD / ACN 081402379; row 3 BLACKBURNE & DIXON PTY LTD / 008876033. Banning record status is not company registration status.

items.title: ACNC Registered Charities
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Register CSV supplies Charity_Legal_Name, ABN, address and website fields with populated organisation records. Charities are not necessarily companies; registration and status are ACNC-specific.

items.title: Victorian Government Schools ABNs
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Sheet1 row 2 Alberton Primary School / 35954747085, row 3 Allansford and District Primary School / 37051817052. ABN-bearing public organisations qualify under the broad organisation criterion; this is a historical 2015 extract.

items.title: Liquor licence premises list
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: CSV row 2 Charlestown Golf Club Ltd / licence LIQC300200019 and separate Licensee Name; row 3 Barooga Sports Club Ltd. Identifiable venues/holders, not anonymous licence totals.

items.title: ACNC 2018 Annual Information Statement Data
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Group-member workbook row 2 Purpose Real Estate Ltd / 11616332444; row 3 G-Force Recruitment Ltd / 15006145222. Member charities and group names are separate fields; no group-to-member identity merge.

items.title: ACNC 2020 Annual Information Statement (AIS) Data
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: AIS CSV names Sydney Missionary & Bible College / 11000047950 and Integricare Limited / 11000073870, with reporting dates and websites. Organisation-year grain; repeated years are not new entities.

items.title: ACNC 2022 Annual Information Statement (AIS) Data
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: 2022 AIS CSV again supplies named charities, ABNs, reporting dates and financial fields. Relevance is supported, but overlap with other ACNC years is not independent corroboration.

items.title: ACNC 2019 Annual Information Statement Data
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: 2019 AIS CSV includes ABN, charity name, other names and address fields with populated charity rows. Historic yearly returns require group and period handling.

items.title: Suitable Operator Register (SOR) for Environmentally Relevant Activities (ERAs)
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Workbook identifies OVER THE TOP ROOF RESTORATIONS PTY. LTD / ACN 090444714 and $Uccess Pty Ltd / ACN 600137942, explicitly Corporation (Company). Operator registration status is source-specific.

items.title: ACNC 2015 Annual Information Statement Data
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Main XLSX exceeded the 30 MB audit limit. Publisher explanatory PDF page 3 explicitly defines charity ABN and formal legal-name fields for each record. Documentary support only; main 2015 rows not inspected in this fresh audit.

items.title: ACNC 2017 Annual Information Statement Data
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Main XLSX exceeded audit limit, but group-reporting workbook member sheet identifies Abundant Life Church Incorporated / 11595120337 and its PBI operator / 29146062217. Group summary and member identities must stay distinct.

items.title: ACNC 2014 Annual Information Statement data
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Companion group workbook lists BOND UNIVERSITY LIMITED / 88010694121 and CAMPUS OPERATIONS PTY. LTD. / 54010929316. Main XLSX exceeded limit; positive based on actual member rows, not synthetic group IDs.

items.title: Employment Services Provider Locations and Contacts
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Initial collector newline parsing failed; follow-up reads raw artifact with newline-safe CSV. Rows 2–4 name Vision Australia and Job Centre Australia with locations. These are service sites, lacking strong entity identifiers.

items.title: Junior Minerals Exploration Incentive credit allocations
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Annual workbook sheets name Alchemy Resources Limited / 17124444122 and Andromeda Metals Limited / 75061503375 alongside allocations. Entity-year monetary data, not anonymous totals.

items.title: Intellectual Property Longitudinal Research Data (IPLORD)
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Follow-up party_name rows identify bacoz developments pty ltd. Party/year IP statistics retain organisation identity; synthetic party IDs are not ABNs and cannot prove identity alone.

items.title: Victorian liquor licences by location
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Location CSV contains LicenseeName, TradingAs, premises fields; OAKLAND HUNT CLUB appears as holder and trading name. Distinguish individual holders and venue names from legal entities.

items.title: Fair Jobs Code Registers

items.evidence: Certificate rows name Zauner Construction Pty Limited / 21087732607 and ELLIS AIR CONDITIONING PROPRIETARY LIMITED / 13004601790. Identifiable organisations; code certification status is not corporate status.

items.title: Companies 1863 to 1959
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Historical company-register index metadata is plausible, but sampled Queensland download returned an empty resource. No company rows inspected; historical scope would also limit current usefulness.

items.title: Notifiable Invoices Register

items.evidence: Notifiable Invoices CSV and JSON endpoints both returned HTTP 403. Supplier records could qualify, but no rows inspected.

items.evidence: Mount Gambier traders CSV returned HTTP 403. Metadata mentions company/owner history, but actual content could not be confirmed.

items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Both State Library contract CSV downloads returned empty resources. Claimed contract/supplier content is unverified; no empty file treated as evidence.

items.title: Corporate Services Division Contract Disclosure

items.title: Contracts Register

items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: CSV delimiter parse failed; declaration PDF page 1 explicitly names VostroNet (Australia) Pty Ltd, ABN 64 602 624 215 and ACN 602 624 215. Company is the declaring subject, not incidental. Superloop affiliation must not become identity.

items.title: WGEA Dataset

items.evidence: Newest resources labelled CSV are ZIP archives; initial decoding failed and a full download exceeded the audit limit. Follow-up 2022 organisation-list CSV names Integricare / 11000073870, Morris Mcmahon and Colas with ABNs. Relevance supported by older actual rows; latest-year payload not verified.

items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)

items.evidence: Application table alone lacks names; PBR party-activity follow-up row 2 identifies grasslanz technology limited, party_type organisation, role applicant. ABN blank; relevant foreign organisations need not be automatically linkable.

items.title: IPGOD2021 [SUPERSEDED]
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Design party-activity follow-up row 2 identifies watson chiarella pty ltd, party_type organisation, role opposition_respondent. Historical/superseded data; role is distinct from applicant/owner.

items.title: Energy Rating Data for household appliances – Non Labelled products
items.reviewer: assistant evidence audit (separate from Jev ranking and Luna inference)
items.evidence: Product rows expose brand Daikin and brand/product website, but no verified legal organisation or supplier identity in inspected fields. Brand can denote several related businesses. Under the declared identifiable-organisation criterion, this is insufficient to mark relevant or prove the entire dataset irrelevant.

items.evidence: TEL Register workbook row 2 names SYNTECH RESOURCES PTY LTD as holder; later rows include TA Australia Security Agent Pty Ltd and DGR GLOBAL LIMITED. Licences/activities/locations are distinct from entity status.
